# Rudder Docs

> Rudder is an open-source operating layer for AI agent teams. It coordinates goals, conversational Chat, structured issues, agent runs, reviews, budgets, workspaces, skills, and feedback loops so humans can run agent work with clear context and evidence.

Rudder is useful when agent work needs to be assigned, run, reviewed, budgeted, and improved over repeated loops. The product is local-first and supports local CLI-backed runtimes such as Codex and Claude Code, shell process runtimes, HTTP webhooks, and gateway-backed agents.

## Start here

- [Rudder overview](https://docs.rudderhq.dev): Product introduction and path selector.
- [About Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/about): What Rudder is, why it exists, and how the agent-work loop compounds.
- [Contact](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/contact): Where to ask questions, report bugs, request features, or follow development.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/get-started/installation): Install Rudder Desktop and the CLI.
- [Create Your First AI Agent Team Organization](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/get-started/first-organization): First end-to-end human-agent work loop.
- [Rudder Releases](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/releases): Stable release changelog and upgrade notes.

## Core concepts

- [Core Concepts](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/overview): Organizations, goals, projects, issues, agents, runs, reviews, workspaces, skills, and feedback.
- [Agents In Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/agents): Durable AI team members with roles, runtime configuration, capabilities, budgets, skills, and reporting boundaries.
- [Rudder Built-in Browser](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/built-in-browser): Local Desktop web sessions, bounded agent browser tools, import behavior, and trust boundaries.
- [Issues For AI Agent Work](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/issues): Durable execution objects for context, ownership, status, runs, blockers, reviews, and outputs.
- [Chat And Messenger For Agent Work](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/chat-messenger): Chat for conversation-driven task execution and Messenger for attention recovery.
- [Workspaces For Agent Files And Outputs](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/workspaces): Project resources, agent-private files, organization artifacts, and durable outputs.
- [Skills For Reusable Agent Workflows](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/concepts/skills): Reusable operating instructions for repeated agent workflows.

## How-to guides

- [Run An AI Agent Issue From Intake To Done](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/issue-lifecycle): Status, assignee, reviewer, evidence, and close-out guidance.
- [Create An AI Agent In Rudder](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/create-agent): Create an agent with role, responsibility, runtime, capabilities, and boundaries.
- [Configure Feishu Or Lark For A Rudder Agent](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/configure-feishu-integration): Connect one Rudder agent to one Feishu or Lark bot and add the `/new` and `/stop` commands.
- [Configure Codex, Claude Code, Or Another Agent Runtime](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/how-to/configure-agent-runtime): Connect local CLI, shell process, webhook, or gateway-backed runtimes.

## Chinese docs

- [Rudder 中文首页](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh): 中文产品介绍和入口。

- [创建第一个组织](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/get-started/first-organization): 用真实任务走通第一条人类-agent 协作循环。
- [内置 Browser](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/concepts/built-in-browser): 理解共享网站 session、agent 控制隔离和本地平台边界。
- [版本发布](https://docs.rudderhq.dev/zh/releases): Rudder 稳定版本发布记录和升级说明。
